excerpt: Fig. 1 is captioned as showing scientific and news media articles on mindfulness and/or meditation by year from 1970 to 2015. Empirical scientific articles were searched in Scopus, while media pieces containing mindfulness or meditation were searched in LexisNexis with a similarity filter to minimize double-counting.
overview: The figure caption supplies the empirical basis for the article's claim that both scientific and media attention to mindfulness expanded substantially over the period under review. Its scope is bibliographic rather than clinical: it supports the existence of a hype environment, not the efficacy or inefficacy of mindfulness practices themselves.
title: Media and Science Growth
